_comment: Provider-literal ratchet (G1). Per-file occurrence count of provider-ID references in core. May only go DOWN. Regenerate: node scripts/check-provider-literal-ratchet.mjs --write. Every counted file must have an `allowlist` entry (count, reason, owner, diesAt); the entries are authored by hand and survive --write. Delete this file and the guard when empty.

apps/demo-server/src/fixtures/providers..reason: demo fixtures: the demo server's static provider roster.

apps/demo-server/src/fixtures/world.ts.reason: demo fixtures: the demo world's default provider.

apps/server/src/services/plugins/plugin-.reason: fork pre-completion: `experimental_preCompletionCapabilities()` reports, per provider, which bridges ship the Stop hook; the provider id is a key of that experimental SDK result shape, not a branch (the server check admits any bridge that calls it).
apps/server/src/services/plugins/plugin-.diesAt: when provider plugins declare pre-completion support and the capability result is derived from the registry

apps/server/src/services/threads/thread-.reason: legacy persisted data: pre-v3 codex timelines recorded the native turn id with no checkpoint; the fallback reads them.
apps/server/src/services/threads/thread-.diesAt: legacy-tool-item-backfill migration (stamps the checkpoint onto old rows)

packages/config/src/bb-app-managed-confi.reason: BUNDLED_PROVIDER_IDS: `customModelProviderIdSchema` (live `customModels` config) accepts only a bundled id or an `acp-*` id, so a third-party provider cannot carry custom models today.
packages/config/src/bb-app-managed-confi.diesAt: when customModels accepts any registered provider id

packages/plugin-sdk/src/backend-contract.reason: fork pre-completion: `experimental_preCompletionCapabilities()` reports, per provider, which bridges ship the Stop hook; the provider id is a key of that experimental SDK result shape, not a branch (the server check admits any bridge that calls it).
packages/plugin-sdk/src/backend-contract.diesAt: when provider plugins declare pre-completion support and the capability result is derived from the registry

packages/provider-bridge-protocol/src/as.reason: Claude Code root-query origins alias the assembler's implicit current turn (fork fix fd97a75038); Codex keeps the explicit provider-turn path.
packages/provider-bridge-protocol/src/as.diesAt: when the bridge protocol carries the implicit-origin capability

packages/scripts/src/commands/archive-co.reason: ops script for codex temp sessions: names the `codex` executable, not a provider branch.

packages/scripts/src/lib/seed-perf-fixtu.reason: perf fixture generator: seeds threads for two providers so the timeline benchmark covers both shapes.

plugins/prompt-suggestion/src/pilot.ts.reason: fork Prompt Suggestion quality pilot (dev script): a zero output budget is allowed only for the Codex subscription Terra baseline it targets; the plugin names the provider it measures.
plugins/prompt-suggestion/src/pilot.ts.diesAt: never (pilot targets that baseline) or when the pilot is removed
